parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the central toggle or actuator of the wall switch, made of ABS plastic for durability and insulation.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main control element that toggles the electrical circuit on or off when pressed or flipped.
parts.Movement_description: It moves rotationally or pivotally around a small axis to change the circuit state.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is one of the two rocker panels of the wall switch, made of ABS plastic for electrical insulation and mechanical strength.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to control one side of the dual switch mechanism, toggling one circuit on or off.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots slightly inward or outward when pressed to activate the internal mechanism.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the second rocker panel of the wall switch, also made of ABS plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It controls the second circuit of the dual switch setup, functioning independently from the first switch.
parts.Movement_description: It moves pivotally when pressed, toggling the electrical connection for its assigned circuit.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or mounting plate of the wall switch, made of polycarbonate for rigidity and electrical insulation.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support for the switches and houses the internal wiring and mechanical components.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and fixed to the wall or electrical box.
